title: tests/tracking/test_client.py: build extra SQLite registry databases by copying the cached_db fixture, not by running fresh migrations
answers: My new prompt registry test is slow on Windows CI because each SQLite registry database runs a full migration; how do I avoid that?
How do I create two isolated SQLite-backed prompt registries in a MlflowClient test?
Where are the registry-isolation and workspace-isolation prompt cache test fixtures defined?
body:
Path: Client-level prompt registry tests in tests/tracking/test_client.py that need several SQLite registry databases, covering cache isolation by registry URI, cache isolation by workspace, invalidation scope, and failed-mutation cache preservation. Fixtures isolated_registry_uris and workspace_registry_uri there create the databases.
Rule: Each extra SQLite registry file should be created by shutil.copy2 of the session-scoped cached_db fixture into tmp_path, then addressed as sqlite:///<path>. Do not call MlflowClient against a fresh sqlite path, because each one runs the full schema migration. Put this copying in a shared fixture rather than repeating it inside parametrized tests.
Symptom: Not a user-facing symptom; the review flagged that fresh-migration tests add substantial Windows CI time, eight-plus migrations for a single parametrized test.
Constraints: Applies to SQLite URIs only. For workspace-scoped tests, the fixture sets MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES=true with monkeypatch before the client is created. Tests that set WorkspaceContext still need monkeypatch on mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id as the existing workspace tests do.
applies: Writing or changing tests that create multiple SQLite-backed MlflowClient prompt registries in tests/tracking/test_client.py.
says: Windows continuous integration builds take far too long running prompt registry tests.
Speed up slow prompt registry test execution on Windows continuous integration pipelines.
search: In tests/tracking/test_client.py, tests requiring extra SQLite prompt registry databases must copy the session-scoped cached_db fixture into tmp_path with shutil.copy2 rather than calling MlflowClient against a fresh SQLite path. This avoids running full schema migrations that add substantial Windows CI time during cache isolation and invalidation tests using fixtures isolated_registry_uris or workspace_registry_uri. Applies strictly to SQLite URIs; workspace tests set MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES=true via monkeypatch before client creation, and WorkspaceContext tests still require monkeypatching mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id.
